component.name: Agentic Tuneup Pro
component.summary: Sovereign AI-orchestrated Linux cleaner and performance suite

description.p: Agentic Tuneup Pro (ATP) is a sovereign desktop utility and MCP server designed for Linux power users. Built on a safety-first architecture with zero unquarantined deletions, atomic multi-file rollback, and Polkit-gated system privileges.

ul.li: Parallel declarative disk cleaner for browser caches, build artifacts, and package caches
Zero-loss quarantine engine with byte-parity rollback and cryptographic audit logs
Unified package manager for Native (pacman/apt/dnf), Flatpak, and AppImage
Interactive process tree viewer, systemd service manager, and startup editor
Integrated in-app Starship Agent cockpit with Tier 3 approval consent gates
Headless Starship MCP bridge via Unix domain socket with SO_PEERCRED authentication

description.p: Mother Ship interface refinement across the desktop application:

ul.li: Quieter chrome: removed colored glows, pulsing indicators and decorative emoji icons
Consistent sentence-case labels, restrained font weights and tabular figures
Calmer motion limited to meaningful state changes and live signals

description.p: Second public alpha release hotfixing production webview initialization:

ul.li: Freezes and embeds production React 19 UI assets directly into binary via Tauri CLI
Eliminates fallback devUrl connections to localhost:1420
Hardens async telemetry sampling initialization on Linux GTK main loop
Declarative junk cleaner with zero unquarantined deletions
System monitor with 1 Hz real-time telemetry and health gauge
Unified package and process manager across Native and Flatpak
Starship MCP server bridge and headless stdio JSON-RPC loop
In-app Starship Agent drawer with Task Sheet state machine and approval gates
